---
title: "Scenarios Zoo"
subtitle: "Calculation Contracts and Reference Statistics"
---

`Scenarios.*` contains reusable calculation settings and named workload/system
cases. The [scenario domain reference](../api/scenario-domains.qmd) documents
their class contracts: inputs, equations, assumptions, exclusions, calculated
properties, and examples. The generic [Scenario](../api/engine.scenarios.Scenario.qmd)
class provides a composed scorecard; calculation scenarios expose their own
properties or solver results. [Choosing a Python API](../choosing-an-api.qmd)
explains the distinction.
Use [Classes A–Z](../api/scenario-index.qmd) when you already know a type name.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
import mlsysim

_n_scenarios = len(mlsysim.Scenarios.list())
_ref_subnames = [
    k for k in sorted(dir(mlsysim.ReferenceStats))
    if not k.startswith("_") and k != "list"
]
_n_ref_items = len(mlsysim.ReferenceStats.list())
print(
    f"::: {{.callout-note}}\n"
    f"## Registry Scale\n"
    f"`mlsysim.Scenarios` ships **`{_n_scenarios}`** executable scenario configurations across "
    f"training, serving, compression, networking, reliability, sustainability, agentic harnesses, "
    f"and cyber-physical robotics (indexed in [Scenarios by Domain](../api/scenario-domains.qmd)). "
    f"`mlsysim.ReferenceStats` ships **`{_n_ref_items}`** sourced non-executable comparison anchors "
    f"across **`{len(_ref_subnames)}`** thematic sub-namespaces.\n"
    f":::\n"
)
```

Use `Hardware.*` for devices, `Systems.*` for composed physical systems,
`Infrastructure.*` for facility and grid facts, and `Ops.*` for operational
policies. A reusable calculation selects these facts and supplies its declared
workload assumptions. These categories apply across all textbook volumes.

## Reference statistics (`ReferenceStats.*`)

The tables below highlight representative `ReferenceStats.*` sub-namespaces, followed by a complete index of all registered `ReferenceStats` namespaces. Provenance records where each reference number came from, while its registry path records what kind of fact it is.

```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis
from mlsysim.core.provenance import scalar_value

featured = [
    ("Workload scale anchors", "Workloads"),
    ("Clinical imaging anchors", "ClinicalImaging"),
    ("Energy comparison anchors", "EnergyAnchors"),
    ("Emissions comparison anchors", "EmissionsAnchors"),
    ("Training scale profiles", "TrainingScaleProfiles"),
    ("Storage training corpus", "StorageTrainingCorpus"),
    ("Mobile power envelopes", "MobilePower"),
    ("Phone battery anchors", "PhoneBattery"),
]
featured_keys = {k for _, k in featured}

for title, key in featured:
    reg = getattr(mlsysim.ReferenceStats, key)
    print(f"### {title} (`ReferenceStats.{key}`)\n")
    print("| Entry | Value | Description |")
    print("|:---|:---:|:---|")
    for item in reg.list():
        name = getattr(item, "name", type(item).__name__)
        desc = getattr(item, "description", "") or "---"
        if hasattr(item, "provenance"):
            try:
                val = scalar_value(item)
            except TypeError:
                val = f"{item:~P}"
        else:
            val = item
        print(f"| **{name}** | {val} | {desc} |")
    print()

print("### All `ReferenceStats` Sub-Namespaces\n")
print("| Namespace | Entries | Representative Item |")
print("|:---|:---:|:---|")
for key in _ref_subnames:
    sub = getattr(mlsysim.ReferenceStats, key)
    items = sub.list() if hasattr(sub, "list") else []
    first_attr = next((a for a in sorted(dir(sub)) if not a.startswith("_") and a != "list"), "---")
    print(f"| `ReferenceStats.{key}` | {len(items)} | `{first_attr}` |")
print()
```

## Python Access

```python
import mlsysim

eff_1024 = mlsysim.ReferenceStats.TrainingScaleProfiles.Eff1024Gpu
retinal_photo = mlsysim.ReferenceStats.ClinicalImaging.RetinalPhotoSize
flight_kg = mlsysim.ReferenceStats.EmissionsAnchors.TransatlanticRoundTripCo2Kg
household_year = mlsysim.ReferenceStats.EnergyAnchors.USHouseholdAnnualElectricity
corpus_tokens = mlsysim.ReferenceStats.StorageTrainingCorpus.TrainingTokens
checkpoint_interval = mlsysim.ReferenceStats.StorageTrainingCorpus.CheckpointInterval
```
